parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: <short pause> for so he giveth his beloved sleep. <short pause> Psalm one hundred twenty-seven, verse two.
Father, quiet my striving mind and give me the sleep You give to those You love. <short pause> Amen.
